collection.description: After surviving a frightening storm, a fisher startles at harmless thunder and avoids the shore.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: After surviving a frightening storm, a fisher startles at harmless thunder and avoids the shore.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: They begin with a calm morning beside a trusted companion.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: They mend nets inland and remain useful while recovering.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: They become overwhelmed and leave; the village reconsiders its approach.
